name: chilkat/chilkat
description: Chilkat PHP extension: the CkHttp, CkCrypt2, CkEmail, CkZip, CkFtp2, CkSsh, ... classes, plus vendor/bin/chilkat-install which installs the matching native extension (chilkat.so / chilkat.dll) for your PHP.

suggest.ext-chilkat: The native extension the classes call into; installed by vendor/bin/chilkat-install (see README).
suggest.ext-curl: Lets chilkat-install download the extension with the curl extension instead of stream wrappers.
suggest.ext-zlib: Lets chilkat-install extract the .tar.gz packages without a tar command.
